card.title: 1357th RIFLES
card.text: When this unit takes damage or is fully repaired, it gets +2 attack.
card.flavorText: The 1357th Rifles was a regiment of the 24th Rifle Division of the Red Army during WWII. The division participated in fighting from the early days of Operation Barbarossa in 1941 and up until the German surrender in 1945. In 1941 the division displayed heroic efforts in the Lidy area, and took part in the defense of Kyiv and engaged in heavy defensive fighting in Belarus as part of the 21st Rifle Corps and 13th Army. The division would later be under the control of various armies and actively participated in numerous military operations, including the Battle of Stalingrad, the Donbas offensive, the clearing of Left-bank Ukraine, the Zhytomyr–Berdychiv offensive, the Kamianets–Podilskyi pocket, the Lviv–Sandomierz offensive, the East-Carpathian and West-Carpathian operations, as well as the Moravia-Ostrava and Prague offensives. On June 24, 1945, the division concluded its combat actions, being 100 km away from Prague.
